findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence.js::resumed dialogue hold fails record-review-round when build-review/ is absent
findings.title: resumed dialogue hold fails record-review-round when build-review/ is absent
findings.action: degrade an absent --prior-dir to the no-round-record warning path
findings.disposition_rationale: Fixed in 2733531e: a --prior-dir that does not exist now stores carried_id null with a warning instead of exiting 2. The dialogue-loop round numbering restarting after a resume is pre-existing (build-review/ was never restored into a fresh run dir) and is recorded as discovered scope.

occurrences.title: resumed dialogue hold fails record-review-round when build-review/ is absent

findings.action: warn like the other soft enum fields
findings.disposition_rationale: Fixed in 2733531e: adversarial_outcome goes through enumOrNull and warns without the value; covered by a test.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence.js::collated writer read-then-write is not atomic against a concurrent recorder
findings.title: collated writer read-then-write is not atomic against a concurrent recorder
findings.disposition_rationale: Graft runs one review loop per issue and only writes review-verdict.json after the last pass is recorded, so the recorder and the writer never overlap for one issue; the spec scopes concurrency to the recorder.

occurrences.title: collated writer read-then-write is not atomic against a concurrent recorder

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence.js::writer and recorder accept validate-only flags silently
findings.title: writer and recorder accept validate-only flags silently
findings.action: reject --json, --candidate-schemas and --require-evidence-schema on the write paths
findings.disposition_rationale: The shared EVIDENCE_SPEC flag table already behaves this way for the existing spec-review-verdict and ac-checklist writers; changing it is outside this slice.

occurrences.title: writer and recorder accept validate-only flags silently
